truth: Program crop presets write output metadata over whole synced source lanes. They never mutate, trim, duplicate, or destructively crop source media.

baseline.label: Fix whole camera
baseline.meaning: Applies the crop recipe to the selected lane and current output format until changed by keyframes.

keyframe.label: Animate moment
keyframe.meaning: Writes the crop recipe at the shared playhead for timed punch-ins, reactions, or emphasis.

16:9.label: Wide episode master
16:9.notes: Use for YouTube episodes, Patreon episode video, and episode pages.

9:16.label: Vertical shorts
9:16.notes: Use for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, LinkedIn vertical clips, and mobile-first story exports.

presets.label: Centered
presets.effect: Center pan and keep at least a light safe zoom.
presets.useWhen: The speaker is close to framed correctly and needs a neutral reset.

presets.label: Tighter
presets.effect: Increase zoom moderately from the current crop.
presets.useWhen: The moment wants more energy or closer attention.

presets.label: Looser
presets.effect: Decrease zoom moderately from the current crop.

presets.label: Headroom
presets.effect: Move the crop upward and ensure a moderate safe zoom.
presets.useWhen: The face is sitting too low or there is too much empty space above.

presets.label: Nudge left
presets.effect: Move the crop left with a moderate safe zoom.
presets.useWhen: The speaker is off-center to the left.

presets.label: Nudge right
presets.effect: Move the crop right with a moderate safe zoom.
presets.useWhen: The speaker is off-center to the right.

presets.label: Solo safe
presets.effect: Center the solo speaker with light upward correction and safe zoom.
presets.useWhen: A single speaker should look clean in the wide episode master.

presets.label: Hide desk
presets.effect: Move the crop upward and tighten enough to reduce desk or lower-frame clutter.
presets.useWhen: The camera captured too much desk, lap, floor, or distracting lower-frame content.

presets.label: Weight left
presets.effect: Favor left-side composition with safe zoom.
presets.useWhen: The wide frame needs room on the right for a two-shot, clip, graphic, or visual balance.

presets.label: Weight right
presets.effect: Favor right-side composition with safe zoom.
presets.useWhen: The wide frame needs room on the left for a two-shot, clip, graphic, or visual balance.

presets.label: Vertical solo
presets.effect: Center and tighten the speaker for vertical mobile viewing.
presets.useWhen: One speaker should carry a short, reel, or story segment.

presets.label: Vertical punch
presets.effect: Add a larger zoom increase from the current crop.
presets.useWhen: A vertical short needs a stronger emphasis beat.

presets.label: Stack top
presets.effect: Prepare this lane for the upper slot in a stacked two-speaker vertical layout.
presets.useWhen: Both speakers are visible in a vertical short and this speaker belongs on top.

presets.label: Stack bottom
presets.effect: Prepare this lane for the lower slot in a stacked two-speaker vertical layout.
presets.useWhen: Both speakers are visible in a vertical short and this speaker belongs on the bottom.
